About

00:00 — 03:40
Kyler TaySingapore

"I'm a passionate Mass Communication student with a strong interest in radio production, podcasting, and digital media storytelling."

I enjoy working in collaborative creative environments and building media content from the ground up — from the first line of a script to the final cut. I consider myself an eager learner, comfortable picking up new tools and formats quickly, and I like contributing creatively in fast-paced media environments where ideas move fast and deadlines are real.

Where I'm headed

I'm working toward a career producing audio and video content — podcasts, radio segments, and short-form video — that tells stories worth paying attention to. Right now that means saying yes to every production role I can, from scripting to producing to on-the-ground coordination, and learning what makes a story land with an audience.
